title: Malicious code in @expo-probe-ff8e2b/snack-probe-c2a16 (npm)
description: The npm package @expo-probe-ff8e2b/snack-probe-c2a16 includes a dependency that references a mutable git branch on an external repository rather than a fixed version. This allows arbitrary code from the external repository to be executed during npm install via lifecycle scripts. The package's shipped code is minimal, with the actual payload coming from the external git source, which is consistent with reconnaissance-style supply-chain malware.
